nodes.label: Lazy loading below the first screen
nodes.norm_label: lazy loading below the first screen
nodes.rationale: Post-card images and backgrounds and everything below the first screen load near the screen; on /ratgeber/ six card images shared the connection with the main image.

nodes.label: Main image priority (first card in post grids)
nodes.norm_label: main image priority (first card in post grids)
nodes.rationale: The header logo competed with the main image; in loop grids only the first card counts because all cards show their images at one size.

nodes.label: Lazy images keep their sizes attribute
nodes.norm_label: lazy images keep their sizes attribute
nodes.rationale: With sizes="auto" an image sized by its own dimensions takes the width of its box (the TV box grew from 600 to 614 px).

nodes.label: Test features: defer or delay JavaScript, remove jQuery Migrate
nodes.norm_label: test features: defer or delay javascript, remove jquery migrate
nodes.rationale: Needed for 95+ on phones: with them every measured page but one scores 98-100 on phones and 100 on computers.

nodes.label: Delayed scripts ignore the banner focus trap
nodes.norm_label: delayed scripts ignore the banner focus trap
nodes.rationale: Delayed scripts started when the cookie banner moved the focus into its dialog; only a visitor's own focus counts.

nodes.label: Table of contents filled in from the start
nodes.norm_label: table of contents filled in from the start

nodes.label: Cookieless Web Vitals beacon
nodes.rationale: One anonymous beacon per page view (metrics, path, phone-sized or not); no IP, user agent or identifier; deleted after 90 days; automated browsers send nothing.

nodes.label: Page cache (Apache .htaccess delivery)
nodes.rationale: No page cache meant 0.8-1.8 s to the first byte; stored pages are sent by Apache without PHP (8 ms in the local test), or by advanced-cache.php elsewhere.

nodes.label: Local replay of the live site
nodes.norm_label: local replay of the live site
nodes.rationale: Serves the page under test from a local file and static files from a cache; every other host is blocked, REST and non-GET requests are answered locally.

nodes.label: perf-lab README: measuring without touching the live site
nodes.norm_label: perf-lab readme: measuring without touching the live site

nodes.label: Size-matched font fallbacks tuned on the site's texts
nodes.norm_label: size-matched font fallbacks tuned on the site's texts
nodes.rationale: Arial scaled per family so headings break into the same lines before and after Archivo, Public Sans and Work Sans arrive; also in plugin stylesheets; font preloads off because they delayed the main image.

nodes.label: Font fallback checks (line breaks, not average widths)
nodes.norm_label: font fallback checks (line breaks, not average widths)

nodes.label: 5xx and 429 never cached by the replay
nodes.norm_label: 5xx and 429 never cached by the replay

nodes.label: Feature states Off / Test / Live
nodes.rationale: Risky features start in Test (administrators in the Test view or the secret preview link) before visitors get them.

nodes.label: Dashboard checklist (steps that need a person)
nodes.norm_label: dashboard checklist (steps that need a person)

nodes.label: Lab results (Lighthouse 13.6, November 2026)
nodes.rationale: Before / Live / all features on 9 pages, three phone runs and one desktop run each; the replay leaves out the server build time, so the live gain is larger.

nodes.label: LGnet site (WordPress + Elementor)
nodes.rationale: Goal: PageSpeed 95+ on phones and computers and passing Core Web Vitals without changing how the site looks or works.

nodes.label: Build-time measurement per plugin, widget and query
nodes.norm_label: build-time measurement per plugin, widget and query

nodes.label: Images tab: replace a file everywhere, Make lighter (WebP)
nodes.norm_label: images tab: replace a file everywhere, make lighter (webp)
nodes.rationale: The attachment keeps its ID, title and alt text; references in pages, Elementor data, templates and settings are rewritten; old files stay so the replacement can be undone.

nodes.label: README.md: SH Digital speed optimization for LGnet
nodes.norm_label: readme.md: sh digital speed optimization for lgnet

nodes.label: Nothing visible changes (layout and fixture checks)
nodes.norm_label: nothing visible changes (layout and fixture checks)

nodes.label: WebP replacement of the 1.9 MB PNG
nodes.norm_label: webp replacement of the 1.9 mb png
nodes.rationale: /telefonanbieter-schweiz/ stays at 86 on phones until its main image (436 KB at phone size) is replaced with WebP on the Images tab.

nodes.label: Deferred inline scripts kept their code on WordPress 7.1
nodes.norm_label: deferred inline scripts kept their code on wordpress 7.1
nodes.rationale: The tag processor refuses data: URLs, so deferred inline scripts lost their code; they are written in the final pass and the fixture test checks it.

nodes.label: WebP quality applied to the file and its sizes
nodes.norm_label: webp quality applied to the file and its sizes
nodes.rationale: WordPress reset the quality when saving in another format, so every offered quality gave the same file; the 1.9 MB PNG becomes 119 KB, 50 KB at phone size.

nodes.label: Third parties unreachable in the replay
nodes.norm_label: third parties unreachable in the replay
nodes.rationale: Their cost only shows on PageSpeed Insights; layout comparisons need originals that link the same local font files.

nodes.label: Link names and logo alt text in the page language
nodes.norm_label: link names and logo alt text in the page language

nodes.label: Browser cache lifetimes (.htaccess mod_expires)
nodes.rationale: No static file had Cache-Control or Expires; CSS, JS and fonts a year, images 30 days, checked after writing and removed if the site does not answer.

nodes.label: Stylesheets joined into one cached file
nodes.norm_label: stylesheets joined into one cached file
nodes.rationale: 17-19 stylesheets plus Elementor inline CSS per page, joined in the same order; the block library is left out on pages without blocks.

nodes.label: Work Sans served from the site instead of Google
nodes.norm_label: work sans served from the site instead of google

nodes.label: SHD Performance plugin
nodes.rationale: Rewrites each finished page after Elementor and the other plugins and stores it in its own page cache; never edits content or other plugins; deactivating restores the original site.

nodes.label: Cookie banner as Largest Contentful Paint (Cookiez)
nodes.norm_label: cookie banner as largest contentful paint (cookiez)
nodes.rationale: Cookiez waits for window load, then draws a banner whose text was the LCP on most pages; Lighthouse counts a JavaScript-drawn element only after every script that ran before it, so the banner is fast only when the other scripts wait.

nodes.label: Hero slider header jump on phones
nodes.norm_label: hero slider header jump on phones
nodes.rationale: The LGnet Hero Slider measured the floating header after the page was read and Elementor started it twice: three jumps of 72 px.

nodes.label: Image placeholders despite aspect-ratio: unset
nodes.rationale: Site Settings custom CSS removed the width/height placeholder (layout shift 0.21); images get aspect-ratio auto W / H back while loading.

nodes.label: SH Motion keeps the first screen still
nodes.norm_label: sh motion keeps the first screen still
nodes.rationale: SH Motion hid and faded in what visitors had already seen; elements on screen get SH Motion's own opt-out data-fx="none".

nodes.label: Lighthouse Lantern simulation
nodes.rationale: Document server time hardly changes simulated FCP/LCP; a JavaScript-drawn element counts after every earlier script; bandwidth is shared evenly between parallel downloads whatever their priority.
